costumes.name: Medical Rabbit
costumes.description:
Mary costume.
Obtained from an Event Pass.

lines.text: If you're ever feeling sick, give me a call.
Anything I can help you with?
Let me treat you. It won't hurt a bit.
Don't even think about feigning illness. You won't like me when I'm mad.

Um... I'm not entirely sure how things got to this point,
but thanks for reliving the past with me, painful as it was.

Commander, please take care of yourself. 
If you get sick, it would break my heart.

What a relaxing day. 
It's nice not to have any new patients.

Commander? It's time for your physical, where are you?
You're making my job very difficult by doing this, you know...
Are you feeling sick?
The hospital is just ahead. Feel free to stop by and see me.
The Outpost is such a peaceful place.
TLC for the sick, painful shots for the malingers!
Now I can take care of more patients.
Let's increase the dosage, shall we?
Thank you for all that you've done.
Are these for me?
A gift for me? I'm so happy!
Thank you, really.
Would you like your treatment to be more... personalized?

Can you lay on the bed~?
I have a shot I prepared especially for you~
I feel that we're getting closer and closer, I'm so happy!
Need my help?
Your instructions please.
I'll go over and check.
Ready or not, here I come!
Wowee, there sure are a lot of them.
These guys are just like germs.
I better get started with the treatment.
That was close.
Reloading.
I'll be ready in a jiffy.
Call me anytime!
Time for an injection! Still hurt?
Get lost, germs!
Hasta la vista!
Gotta disinfect those germs!
Heehee.
Urgh!
*Gasp*
Argh!
I think... this is as far as I can go...
An apple a day keeps the Raptures away!

Do you think younger patients will get a kick out of this bunny outfit?
Hehe, I'm only joking.
If I'm a rabbit, does that make you a tortoise?
Don't be fooled by my appearance. I'm still a doctor who deserves respect.

Hehe, it seems that you like this outfit.
In that case, I'll wear it whenever you come for a check-up.

I didn't know you were such a fan of animals.
Should I wear a cat or dog outfit next time?

If you're a good boy and lie down on the bed,
I'll make sure this won't hurt.

Is it okay if I head back?
I have a lot of patients waiting for me.

There's no point in trying to run from me, hehe!
Rabbits are very fast runners.
If you find yourself in need of a bunny doctor, give me a shout!
Hop, hop!
Did you call? Are you feeling a bit under the weather?

How do I look?
Pretty adorable, right? Hehe!

Thanks to you,
I think I've become stronger, hehe.
I ought to examine you more thoroughly.

I'll take this as encouragement to work even harder.
Now, when should we book you for your next check up?

Thank you, Commander!
I'll be sure to give you a more thorough examination next time to repay you.
You don't happen to have any carrots on hand, do you? Hehe.
I'm touched! This makes me so happy!

Whenever I look at you, my heart starts to race.
You don't think I have heart problems, do you? Hehe.

I know I'm supposed to treat all my patients fairly,
but with you around, Commander, it's hard to keep that up, hehe.

Hmm... this is most troubling.
I keep imagining all sorts of strange things.
Here comes the bunny doctor!
You called?
Should I hop over there?
That's quite enough from you, you naughty germs!
This injection will be particularly painful!
I'll treat each and every one of you.
Stay behind me, Commander.
Hehe, how terrifying!
Just a moment.
One... two...
Ready for the next physical!
Here comes the needle!
This will make all your pain go away.
Germs, be gone!
Hehe, hehehe!
Next patient!
Ugh...!
Ow!
Argh!

Oh dear...
I'll have to leave the rest to you.
All done! Next patient, please.
